summary: First test run of the Kalshi DD/TD EV scanner (no OpticOdds key). Backend: 8/8 pytest pass (status, live Kalshi games (12 games, from KXNBA2D/KXNBA3D), scan with missing_key, unknown game 404, missing param 422, combo 400 without key, combo 422 bad body). Frontend: amber banner, live rows with yes/no asks, expand/collapse showing 'No sportsbook prices found' message, devig/source toggles, fees/+EV switches, min EV, book chips all work and persist in localStorage across reload; refresh updates timestamp; game select switches games and reloads table; How it works modal opens/closes; Combo Builder game/player selects, leg checkboxes/thresholds (Over X.5 label updates), quote input work; calc button disabled with 'Needs OpticOdds key'. Mobile 390px: no horizontal overflow outside the table on both tabs. No console page errors.

minor.issue: kalshi.load_markets() httpx errors are not caught in /scan and /combo (only in /games) -> raw 500 if Kalshi is down/slow instead of 502.
Leg.threshold has no bounds validation (0 or negative accepted); stat validated only after key check (fine now, but no ge=1 constraint).
If user deselects every book, frontend sends books='' and backend silently falls back to DEFAULT_BOOKS - the UI chips then don't reflect what's priced.

issues: Selected game is local to each page component, so switching tabs resets the game selection back to the first game (minor UX).

action_items: Wrap kalshi.load_markets() in /api/scan and /api/combo with httpx.HTTPError -> HTTPException(502) like /api/games
Optional: add Field(ge=1, le=60) to Leg.threshold; handle empty book selection explicitly (disable or warn)
Optional: App.js getStatus() has no .catch - status failure leaves page silently without banner/books
critical_code_review_comments: DD inclusion-exclusion P(PR)+P(PA)+P(RA)-2P(PRA) is correct; TD = P(PRA). Worst-case on NO side uses 1-max(yes) - correct.
row-expansion-breakdown-{row.key} testid uses raw key with spaces while other row testids replace spaces with '-' (inconsistent)
Kalshi fee formula 0.07*P*(1-P) per contract ignores per-order rounding up to the cent - acceptable approximation but could understate fees on small orders
context_for_next_testing_agent: No OpticOdds key so fair/EV columns are '—' by design. When key is added, retest /api/scan optic_status=ok, breakdown-book-* rows, combo pricing and EV display. Kalshi data is live; game codes like 26OCT23ATLCHA. Expand-empty testid: row-expansion-empty-<key-with-dashes>.
